description: This file defines a PHP class 'Forgotten' within the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Mail'. The class extends a base controller and implements functionality related to the 'forgotten password' email process in the OpenCart platform. It includes methods to generate and send password reset emails to customers, loading necessary models, language strings, and configuring email parameters.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the password forgotten email process in the OpenCart system. It loads customer data by email, constructs a password reset email, and sends it to the customer.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to handle password reset email logic. It retrieves customer information by email, prepares email content, and sends the reset link via email.
